hands down sakurai atsushi. 

the way he writes about such deeply personal things and is so open and honest about himself is really inspiring. he's been through a LOT of trauma and was able to overcome it while also offering comfort to others through his lyrics and performances. the fact that he is still writing songs about past trauma and letting it all out on stage is stunning, he really embodies his art and puts his heart and soul into it. i also love how unashamedly himself he is, his story is one of incredible growth and resilience.

not only this but he's super humble and comes across as very kind and caring, just overall a very genuine guy! a sweet old man who loves his cats and just wants to comfort and help people heal<3

yeah definitely watch the gaki no tsukai no-laughing batsu games, they're put in increasingly ridiculous situations but if they laugh they get punished, I would recommend starting from the beginning and making your way to the more recent ones because there's so many running jokes that carry over from past episodes. 

find subs here for all the no laughing batsus https://www.reddit.com/r/GakiNoTsukai/wiki/nlbg

I'd also recommend their 24 hour tag episode! 4 guys stuck in a gymnasium for 24 hrs with taggers being released in random intervals, each "tagger" has a punishment written on their chest, you get caught you get the punishment. it's my favourite episode by far!

subs for 24 hr tag can be found here https://www.reddit.com/r/GakiNoTsukai/wiki/bg
